messages:
Alex: Heads-up — PR #13421 is green locally but blocked by a macOS matrix flake on CI. Need to land before the deploy-freeze window closes at 16:00 PST tomorrow. Can we get an expedited rerun or a short rebase window? :hourglass:
Maria: On it — requesting a CI rerun and pinging the macos runners team. @ci-bot can you queue a rerun for PR 13421?
ci-bot: Rerun request received for PR 13421; job queued on macos-matrix. Estimated start ~2m. Status: queued.
Taylor: If the rerun still flakes, consider doing a canary rollout on dedicated capacity and then full rollout. Also FYI the rebase window for the freeze closes in ~3h. I can hold a slot if needed.
Jin: I'll take a look at the macOS logs after the rerun. If it's the `TestFileWatcher` timeout again I can add a flake guard / retry. Can someone paste the failing snippet?
Alex: Here's the failing tail from the last CI run:
```
15:32:07 ERROR test_file_watcher.py::TestFileWatcher::test_watch_timeout
TimeoutError: file watcher didn't trigger within 30s
```
Not sure if it's infra or a real flake.
Maria: CI rerun started for PR 13421. Logs: https://ci.redwood.company/build/12345 — status: in-progress.
ci-bot: macos-matrix job #98765 started on runner macos-02.
Jin: Thanks. If it fails again I'll open a tiny test-only fix adding `retry_on_timeout` and request a quick review. Who can approve a test-only change fast?
Taylor: I can approve a minor test-only change. Please tag me and put `[test-only]` in the PR body so it's obvious.
Alex: If rerun passes, can we hold landing until midnight to avoid late-night deploys? We have a deploy freeze 00:00-06:00 UTC tomorrow.
Maria: We avoid merges during freeze; if it passes we can schedule to land right before the freeze unless you want immediate.
Jin: CI failed again (same timeout). I'll open a small patch now.
Maria: CI job #98765 finished: failed. Logs: https://ci.redwood.company/build/12345/logs (same timeout).
Alex: Thanks. @Taylor please watch for the test-only PR. Also can we request a short rebase window if the fix needs a couple iterations?
Taylor: Yep — can give a 1h rebase slot starting in ~30m. If more time is needed escalate to oncall.
ci-bot: Rebase window request noted. oncall-team notified.
Jin: PR 13422 opened: `[test-only] retry file watcher on timeout` — https://git.redwood/repo/pull/13422 — ping @Taylor for review.
Taylor: Quick look -> LGTM. /approve. Will merge once CI is green. :thumbsup:
Maria: Rerun queued for PR 13422 on macos-matrix.
ci-bot: macos-matrix job #98770 for PR 13422 started.
ci-bot: job #98770 passed ✅. All green.
Taylor: Merging now. Plan: canary rollout to dedicated capacity, monitor Redwood Console for errors for 15m, then full land if stable.
Alex: Thanks team. After canary looks good, proceed to full land before the freeze. I'll update release notes and note the testing fix.
Maria: Noted — will update the deploy board and close the rebase slot when done.
ci-bot: All actions completed for PR 13422. Status: merged.
Alex: Great, thanks everyone.
